g.text: How teams change on their second possession

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616c

g.text: Each dot is a team. Changes are measured against its first possessions. Zero means no change.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616c

g.text: Second minus first. −2 means a two-percentage-point decrease in huck share. Dashed line = overall trend.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20272d

g.text: Correlation: r = -0.54 · 95% uncertainty range: -0.68 to +0.25. The range includes zero.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616c

g.text: Source: ShownSpace + audited UFA events · April 24–July 19, 2026 regular season.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616c

g.text: 22 teams · 4,802 first / 457 second possessions · original seven · starts ≥60 yards from goal.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616c

g.text: Team uncertainty can cross quadrant boundaries. Correlation does not establish causation.
